glosses: To start something mechanical, an act that often used to involve cranking.

examples.text: Let's crank up the old motorcycle and take it for a spin.

glosses: To muster up the mental energy to do something.

examples.text: I kept thinking: this has nothing to do with my interests, with what I believe is a desirable subject for literature. I was doing it as a performance. I kept cranking myself up to perform, to meet the demands of the genre. I know this sounds terribly inartistic.

glosses: To prepare (something).
To increase, as the volume, power or energy of something.

examples.text: He cranked up the volume to 11.

glosses: To describe in praiseworthy terms; to promote.

examples.text: Was the great machine ever what it was cranked up to be?
